clue.text: Commanding officer firm with fanatic for fruit

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
a nut is an enthusiast or fanatic, as in a fitness nut

explanation.surface: An army commander and a zealous business partner go looking for something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The coconut is the large hard-shelled fruit of a tropical palm.

clue.text: Farm hand is constant female with lowered head

parts.note: C is the symbol for a constant in maths and for the speed of light

indicators.note: with lowered head says the first letter of the word drops one place down

parts.note: a woman is an adult female

explanation.surface: A farm worker is a steady woman who walks with her head bowed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with lowered head' moves the W of WOMAN down one place, giving OWMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowman tends cattle on a farm, so he is one kind of farm labourer.

clue.text: Child crazy about consumed treat

indicators.note: about says the word for crazy is turned round

parts.note: loco is slang for crazy
ate means consumed, eaten

explanation.surface: A child goes wild over a sweet he has just eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Chocolate is a sweet food often given as a reward or indulgence.

clue.text: Wanting river to rise in New York

indicators.note: in places the turned word inside the letters for New York
to rise in a down clue means reading the word upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland

explanation.surface: A river lacks water until it swells somewhere in New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to rise' turns DEE into EED, read upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Needy means poor or lacking necessities, so wanting in the sense of lacking.

clue.text: Wreck of Titanic contains account for strategist

indicators.note: contains says the jumbled letters hold the two-letter abbreviation
wreck of means the letters of the ship's name are smashed up and rearranged

explanation.surface: The sunken ship holds a story fit for a military planner.
explanation.definitionFit: A tactician plans manoeuvres skilfully, much like a strategist planning moves.

clue.text: Watch idiot in space returning

indicators.note: in places the word for idiot inside the turned-round word for space
returning tells us the word for space is read backwards

parts.note: room means space, as in room to move
a nit is a foolish person, a nitwit

explanation.surface: Keep an eye on a fool floating about in outer space as he comes home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns the word for space round to MOOR before 'in' puts the idiot inside it; 'Watch' is a verb here, not a timepiece.
explanation.definitionFit: To monitor something is to observe or keep it under watch, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Setter's holding single note perhaps

definitions.note: a banknote is one example, hence perhaps

indicators.note: holding says the setter's word wraps around the number

parts.note: the setter's means belonging to me, the setter, so my
one means single

explanation.surface: The crossword compiler is keeping one banknote back.
explanation.definitionFit: A banknote is a form of cash, so it is one example of currency.

clue.text: Rotten acorn nut left out at night

indicators.note: rotten suggests the nut has decayed and its letters have fallen into a new order

explanation.surface: A decaying acorn is abandoned outside overnight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' reads as part of 'left out' but belongs with the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Nocturnal creatures are active after dark, so they are about in the hours of darkness.

clue.text: Perhaps canine is overly tough on the outside

parts.note: too means overly, excessively

indicators.note: on the outside takes the outer letters of the word tough

explanation.surface: A dog seems far too hard on the outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canine' looks like a dog, but here it is a pointed tooth, one example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A canine is the pointed tooth beside the incisors, so it exemplifies the answer.

clue.text: Relax around middle of Azores holiday spot

indicators.note: around says the word for relax wraps the middle letters

parts.note: rest means relax

indicators.note: middle of takes the central two letters of Azores

explanation.surface: Unwind in the heart of the Azores at a holiday destination.
explanation.definitionFit: A resort is a place people visit for holidays and recreation.

clue.text: Which people get the French undivided

parts.note: who asks which people, as in who is coming?
le is the French masculine word for the

explanation.surface: A question about which people end up with the French intact.
explanation.definitionFit: Something whole is complete and entire, in one piece, not split up.

clue.text: Deliberate disadvantages to Conservative promises

parts.note: cons are drawbacks, as in pros and cons
C is the abbreviation for Conservative, the UK political party
IOUs are written promises to pay a debt

explanation.surface: A politician weighs the drawbacks of Tory pledges with care.
explanation.definitionFit: A conscious act is intentional, done knowingly and on purpose, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Many tiny flies around Oscar providing invisibility

indicators.note: around says the scrambled letters wrap about the O
flies suggests the letters scatter wildly, so the two words are rearranged

parts.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A swarm of small insects buzzes round an award statuette, hiding it from view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flies' looks like the insects themselves, but it is the anagram signal on MANY TINY.
explanation.definitionFit: Anonymity means being unknown or unseen by others, figuratively a kind of invisibility.

clue.text: Employer embraces husband and doorkeeper

indicators.note: embraces means the first word wraps around the second like a hug

parts.note: a user is one who employs something
H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogy

explanation.surface: A boss hugs her husband and the man who guards the door.
explanation.definitionFit: An usher is an official who keeps a door or shows people to their seats.

clue.text: Distant motorway building

definitions.note: a noun here: a farm is a farmhouse with its outbuildings

parts.note: far means distant
M is the road prefix for British motorways, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A construction project going on beside a remote motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building' reads as a verb about road construction, but it is a noun: a farm as in a farmhouse and its outbuildings.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm can mean the farmhouse and its barns, so the property counts as a building.

clue.text: Awkward dolt, Maria, is clumsy

indicators.note: awkward suggests the letters sit badly and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Maria is an awkward dolt and cannot do anything gracefully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awkward' looks like the definition, but it is the anagram signal; the definition is at the other end.
explanation.definitionFit: Maladroit means lacking skill or grace, a direct synonym for inept or bungling.

clue.text: Most unhinged Asian regularly seen between homes

indicators.note: between places the picked letters in the gap between the two words for home

parts.note: two words for home flank the middle: IN (at home) and NEST

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word Asian

explanation.surface: An Asian traveller is often spotted shuttling between houses in a frenzy.
explanation.walkthrough: The one word 'homes' supplies two pieces, one at each side; 'regularly' takes the even letters of Asian, S and A, and 'between' sets them in the gap.
explanation.definitionFit: Insane means mad or unhinged; the superlative form gives most unhinged.

clue.text: Beats idiots after drink involving drop of rum

indicators.note: after places the fools at the end, following the drink
involving says the word for drink takes in the letter

parts.note: to sup is to drink, and a sup is a sip

indicators.note: drop of takes just the first letter of rum, a drop being a tiny amount

parts.note: asses are fools or idiots

explanation.surface: Fools who have been drinking rum start throwing punches.
explanation.definitionFit: To surpass is to outdo or exceed, so it means beats in the sense of outperforms.

clue.text: Stopped flow of blood from cut hands damaged with end of knife

indicators.note: damaged means the letters are broken up and reassembled
end of takes only the closing letter of the word knife

explanation.surface: Someone stems the bleeding from hands sliced by the tip of a knife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges CUTHANDS plus E, the last letter of 'knife'.
explanation.definitionFit: To staunch a wound is to stop the bleeding, so the past tense means stopped the bleeding.

clue.text: German to live on river boat

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
R is the abbreviation for river on maps
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A man from Germany decides to spend his life aboard a riverboat.
explanation.definitionFit: A Berliner is a native of Berlin, so a German by birth.

clue.text: Liberal lout is idle

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for Liberal, a UK political party
an oaf is a clumsy lout

explanation.surface: A lazy politician lounging about doing nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: To loaf is to lounge around lazily doing nothing, a verb phrase match.

clue.text: Bronze compass point in chest

parts.note: Br is a dictionary abbreviation for bronze
east is one of the four cardinal compass points

explanation.surface: A bronze compass is stored inside a trunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chest' suggests a storage box, but it is the front of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: The breast is the front of the upper body, which is another word for the chest.

clue.text: Ability to hide bit of dry dust

indicators.note: to hide means the first word conceals the letter inside it

parts.note: power means capability or ability

indicators.note: bit of takes just the first letter of dry

explanation.surface: Someone has the knack of concealing a speck of dried dirt.
explanation.definitionFit: Powder is fine dry particles, the same as dust in its loose form.

clue.text: Finish off set of drinks in rotation

definitions.meaning: to complete or finish something neatly
a set of drinks bought for a group at the pub
an adverb sense, as in the wheels go ..., turning in a circle

explanation.definitionFit: The word means completing, a batch of pub drinks, and turning in a circle.

clue.text: Taste underlying mustard and mace ingredients first of all

indicators.note: first of all takes the opening letter of each of the five words before it

explanation.surface: A savoury flavour lies beneath the mustard and mace in a recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Umami is the savoury flavour, counted as the fifth basic taste.

clue.text: Verbally attacks untidy stationer

indicators.note: untidy tells us the letters of the word are left in a mess and rearranged

explanation.surface: A customer berates a stationer whose shop is in disarray.
explanation.definitionFit: To tear into someone is an idiom for criticising or berating them fiercely.

clue.text: Things over there start to tear stockings

indicators.note: start to means only the opening letter of the next word is taken

parts.note: hose means stockings or tights

explanation.surface: Those things across the room are tights beginning to rip.
explanation.definitionFit: Those is the plural demonstrative pointing at items at a distance.

clue.text: Disturb small fish

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes
hake is a sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Upset a tiny fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To shake someone is to unsettle or upset them emotionally.

clue.text: Comparable articles on symbol by American

parts.note: an and a are the two indefinite articles in English
a logo is a symbol representing a brand
US is short for American, as in US citizens

explanation.surface: Magazine pieces about an American brand emblem are much alike.
explanation.definitionFit: Analogous means similar or parallel in some respect, so able to be compared.

clue.text: Part of photograph identifies louse

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A close-up picture helps an entomologist identify a parasite.
explanation.definitionFit: Aphids are also called plant lice, small sap-sucking insects, so louse is fair.

clue.text: One way lake gets covered by the plant

indicators.note: gets covered by means the run of letters sits inside the word the

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one
St is the abbreviation for street, a way
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A single path to a lake is overgrown by vegetation.
explanation.definitionFit: The thistle is a prickly flowering plant, the emblem of Scotland.

clue.text: Son and uncle possibly faint

parts.note: uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker, who is one kind of lender

explanation.surface: A boy and his uncle both feel faint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uncle' as slang for a pawnbroker is old British usage; 'possibly' marks it as an example of a lender.
explanation.definitionFit: Slender can mean slight or faint, as in a slender chance of success.
